src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2024_us_cd119_500k
cd.vint: The Census Bureau's lines of the 119th Congress's districts (its file says session 119).
rec: Chapter 92 of the Laws of 2024 (S.8653-A / A.9310-A), the Legislature's congressional plan, passed and signed Feb. 28, 2024; 26 districts
N.Y. Assembly bill page A.9310-A / S.8653-A: signed chap. 92 on 02/28/2024

It followed the Court of Appeals' Dec. 2023 Hoffmann decision (reported by the League of Women Voters and others; the court's own opinion page answered 403 to scripts and was not opened) that sent the map back to the commission. Replaced the 2022 court map for the Nov. 5, 2024 election. Census cb_2024 cd119 file: 26 districts; 17 of 26 areas differ by more than 0.5 percent from the 2022 file (up to 41 percent), as the Legislature's Feb. 2024 changes (Long Island, Hudson Valley, Syracuse) would.

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2024_us_sldu_500k
sldu.vint: The Census Bureau's 2024 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2024 legislative session year.
rec: Same special-master State Senate plan as 2022 (certified May 20, 2022); 63 districts
N.Y. Supreme Court, Steuben County, Harkenrider v Hochul, Decision and Order of May 20, 2022 (certifies the 2022 Congressional and State Senate maps)

That no act or order changed the Senate map after May 2022 rests on Loyola's page (secondary) and on the 2023 act's text, which covers the Assembly only; nysenate.gov refuses scripts (403) so the Senate's own pages were not read. Census cb_2024 sldu file (LSY 2024) equals the 2022 file in every district (max difference 0.0 percent), as it would if the map did not change.

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2024_us_sldl_500k
sldl.vint: The Census Bureau's 2024 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2024 legislative session year.
rec: Chapter 127 of the Laws of 2023 (S.6454 / A.6586, signed Apr. 24, 2023): the 150 Assembly districts 'for the 2024 and subsequent elections', the commission's second plan, replacing the 2022 plan after Nichols v. Hochul
N.Y. Assembly bill page A.6586 / S.6454: signed chap. 127; summary 'Establishes the 150 assembly districts for the 2024 and subsequent elections'

Verified against the files: for the 6 Assembly districts made only of whole towns that differ between the 2022 and 2023 plans, the change in land area from plan to plan equals the change from the cb_2022 file to the cb_2024 file to within 0.2 sq km (District 121: -1,158.8 sq km both; District 131: +646.0 sq km both; District 122: +29.0 both), so the cb_2024 file holds this plan. 54 of 150 districts differ by more than 0.5 percent from the 2022 file. Census cb_2024 sldl: LSY 2024, 150 districts. The commission's plan largely repeated the existing lines (press reports), but not in every district.
